chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Nazarro held them back; they were too loyal to leave
summary: Bubbles is sure Nazarro feared losing them, while they stayed out of gratitude for his bringing them up in New York.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Do you feel that Nat Nazarro held you back from being bigger than you were?

Oh, I know that. That's without a doubt. Sure. Sure, man. No ifs, ands or buts about it. He was afraid that we would get too big and he would lose us. That was the idea, I'm sure. See what I mean? 'Cause

many people wanted us to leave him. Many people. We didn't have brains enough. We were too grateful and too loyal to do that. We thought the fella brought us up -- he took us over when we got to New York from this other guy that was so sad and we thought we were still paying the respect. But we didn't know at the same time this was a trick of his that he'd been doing. No, I didn't know that. But that's the way life went.
